channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood and tornado emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Updated hourly during flood or severe weather and twice daily otherwise. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Coastal Flood Statement · Kenedy Island, Willacy Island, Cameron Island
item.description: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 24 at 5:58PM CST until November 25 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Brownsville TX. In effect until Nov 25, 6:00 AM CT. Areas: Kenedy Island, Willacy Island, Cameron Island. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
